description: Parse a Specctra .dsn autorouter file from KiCad, Altium, Allegro, or EasyEDA to extract resolution units, copper layers, and netlist pin counts. Call during pre-flight inspection for .dsn exports instead of native .kicad_pcb files. Accepts dsn_text or project_path; returns JSON unit, resolution, layer_count, and net_count. Example: project_path='design.dsn'.

dsn_text.description: Raw UTF-8 Specctra .dsn S-expression text from ECAD export.

project_path.description: Local filesystem path to a Specctra .dsn file (STDIO).

name: analyze_specctra_dsn
title: Analyze Specctra DSN Autorouter File
